items.exampleEn: We held a concert to raise money.
items.exampleZh: 我們辦了一場音樂會來募款。

items.exampleEn: When sales fell, the shop quickly took steps to attract new customers.
items.exampleZh: 銷量下滑時，那家店很快就採取措施吸引新顧客。

items.exampleEn: If nobody takes action, the problem will get worse.
items.exampleZh: 如果沒有人採取行動，問題會變得更嚴重。

items.exampleEn: Some people perform best under pressure.
items.exampleZh: 有些人在壓力下反而表現得最好。

items.exampleEn: Don't worry, everything is under control.
items.exampleZh: 別擔心，一切都在掌控之中。

items.exampleEn: Is this map up to date?

items.sentenceEn: Our teacher keeps the class under control.
items.sentenceZh: 我們老師把班上管得井然有序。

items.audioEn: Please keep your computer up to date, or some programs may stop working.
items.audioZh: 請讓你的電腦保持在最新狀態，否則有些程式可能會無法使用。
items.questionZh: 說話者提醒聽者做什麼？
options: Install the newest updates on the computer
Buy a new computer before the old one stops working
Turn the computer off at night

items.sentenceEn: Many workers feel under pressure at the end of the year.
items.sentenceZh: 很多上班族到了年底都覺得壓力很大。

items.sentenceEn: It's time to take action on climate change.
items.sentenceZh: 該是對氣候變遷採取行動的時候了。

items.stemEn: The club is selling cakes to ____ for a new piano.
items.stemZh: 社團在賣蛋糕，為買新鋼琴募款。

items.stemEn: The manager stayed calm even when she was ____.
items.stemZh: 即使承受壓力，經理還是保持冷靜。

items.passageEn: Our school wants to become greener, so the student council has taken steps to cut waste. First, it raised money by selling old books and toys, and used the money to buy water fountains. The council also keeps a list of how much trash each class produces, and the list is always up to date. When one class's trash got out of control in March, the council took action right away and gave that class a lesson on recycling.
items.passageZh: 我們學校想變得更環保，所以學生會已經採取措施減少垃圾。首先，他們賣舊書和玩具來募款，用這筆錢買了飲水機。學生會也記錄每一班產生多少垃圾，而且這份名單一直都是最新的。三月時，有一班的垃圾量失控，學生會馬上採取行動，替那一班上了一堂回收課。

questions.questionZh: 三月時學生會做了什麼？
options: 把舊書和玩具賣給附近居民
請全校學生寫一份報告
買了好幾台新的飲水機

items.promptZh: 公司已經採取措施，讓員工可以在家工作。
referenceEn: The company has taken steps to let staff work from home.
The company has already taken steps so that employees can work from home.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「採取措施」（例如 has taken steps 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 has taken measures、has done something 等）
有「已經」，用現在完成式（例如 has taken 等）；寫過去式 took steps 也正確

referenceEn: This list is not up to date.
This list isn't up to date.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「最新的」（例如 up to date 等；寫成 up-to-date 也正確）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 This list is out of date、is outdated、isn't the latest 等）
否定可寫，例如 is not、isn't 等
